name: neurova.com.co
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But no content security policy.
lesson: Tighten the content security policy one directive at a time, starting from default-src 'self'.
summary: www.neurova.com.co scores 88 out of 100 (B). 0 checks fail now, 11 are at risk, and 43 pass. Fix first: no content security policy.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: Tracking starts on load and no banner asks first
fix.evidence: No cookie banner appeared. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw Google Analytics (2 requests), and cookies _ga_RX5BGDVT5P, _ga.
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

fix.title: Tracking tags load with no consent tool in the page
fix.evidence: Google Analytics 4 appears in the HTML and no consent platform or Google Consent Mode default was found. In the EU, the UK, Brazil, and Colombia this is a legal exposure.
fix.fix: Add a consent platform and set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads.

fix.title: No DMARC policy
fix.evidence: _dmarc.neurova.com.co has no v=DMARC1 record. Spoofed mail from this domain is not rejected, and Gmail and Yahoo now expect DMARC from bulk senders.
fix.fix: Start with p=none and a rua address, then move to quarantine or reject.

fix.title: No privacy notice is linked
fix.evidence: None of the 20 pages analyzed, nor the rendered start page, links a privacy notice, yet the site sets cookies, loads Google Analytics 4. Visitors cannot see who handles their data or why.
fix.fix: Publish a privacy notice that names who controls the data, what is collected, why, and the visitor's rights, and link it from the footer of every page.

fix.title: The ProfessionalService entity is incomplete
fix.evidence: 7 profiles linked on the page are not in sameAs (wa.me, wa.me, wa.me and 4 more).
fix.fix: Complete the entity so AI answers connect the brand to its profiles. The fix kit has a draft.
